messages:
maria: heads-up — planning a micro-rollout of cinder11b:v2 into the catalog tonight during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. aiming for 5% traffic for 30m then 25% if metrics look clean.
kevin: ack. can we pin the old variant for enterprise customers during the initial phase? i'd rather avoid early surprises. @maria
lisa: +1 on pinning. i can push a pinlist that maps enterprise -> cinder11b:v1 until we hit 25%.
jonah: what fallback ordering are we using if latency spikes? will we fallback to cinder11b:v1 or to quantized orbiter-8b?
sre-ops: fallback priority proposal: 1) pinned variant (v1) for customers with explicit pins, 2) cinder11b:v1 (un-pinned general), 3) orbiter-8b-quant (cost-safe fallback). keep cinder11b:v2 last-resort evict.
maria: that ordering matches my thought. also want an automatic rollback threshold: p50 > 600ms OR error rate increase > 1.5x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes.
kevin: add QPS drop heuristic too — if tail drop > 10% for 2 windows we'll rollback.
jonah: deploy-bot, can you schedule a micro-canary job and post the deploy checklist?
deploy-bot: scheduling micro-rollout: catalog.enable request queued. changewindow=2026-03-22T02:00Z-03:00Z, rollout=5%->25%, steady=30m. monitors=[p50,p95,errors,qps]. trigger=/run deploy catalog enable cinder11b:v2 --micro 5%
maria: thanks. i'll add quick smoke prompts and the eval set for semantic regression (SMOKE_SET_ALPHA). pls watch hallucination rate on the eval.
lisa: pinned mapping ready: {"enterprise": "cinder11b:v1"} — will apply 30m before rollout.
sre-ops: alert hooks: paging if p95 > 1100ms OR error_rate > baseline*1.5. also posting a dashboard link: https://console/redwood/dashboards/cinder11b-micro
kevin: rollback runbook snippet (for oncall):
```
# emergency rollback
deploy-bot: /run deploy catalog rollback --model=cinder11b:v2 --to=cinder11b:v1 --reason="latency spike"
# pin old variant for 1h
api call: POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"enterprise","model":"cinder11b:v1","ttl":"1h"}
```
jonah: if we need a partial rollback (stop 5% canary only) is there a command?
deploy-bot: yes: `/run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=cinder11b:v2 --percent=0` will remove traffic for the model without touching pins.
maria: post-rollout checklist: 1) confirm eval set passes, 2) no customer-facing errors, 3) cost runbook check (token utilization within expected), 4) handoff to platform for 24h watch.
lisa: i'll send a short release note to #general and update the catalog changelog entry.
kevin: assigning oncall: @jonah (primary) @sre-ops (backup) for the 03:00-05:00 UTC window.
jonah: i'll be onpager. will keep a live thread in #eng-releases and ping if any degradations. :thumbsup:
maria: all set. i'll push the micro-rollout job at +10m so we have buffer. thanks everyone.
